items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there was the Count Basie Orchestra, with Don Byas and Lester Young at the same time–of course, I was interested in the tenor players. And we would stand there all night and watch.

ctx.x: And um...that was the environment there in Detroit, this input of musicians from out of town: Coleman Hawkins and there was the Count Basie Orchestra, with Don Byas and Lester Young at the same time–of course, I was interested in the tenor players. And we would stand there all night and watch. We did very little dancing.
